sz-Ak5Y.title: Guardrail: divided highway, metal and stone
sz-Ak5Y.summary: A road split by metal and stone guardrails, running from Manzini to the border. It is the only divided highway in the country.

sz-NeZB.title: Plants: pine plantations in the west
sz-NeZB.summary: Pine plantations in a few western areas. South Africa has similar ones.

sz-Os75.title: Pole: dark brown wood, side insulators
sz-Os75.summary: Simple dark brown wooden poles with the insulators mounted on the side. Poles with three insulators on top are more common here than elsewhere in Southern Africa.

sz-P8gV.title: Sign: road numbers starting with MR
sz-P8gV.summary: Road numbers that start with the letters MR only exist in this country.

sz-PD9f.title: Crops: sugar cane along the east border
sz-PD9f.summary: Sugar cane fields appear in several places along the eastern border.

sz-PQbM.title: Google car: white car, no antenna
sz-PQbM.summary: The car is white with no antenna. South Africa, Lesotho and Botswana have this same car, so it only narrows the region.

sz-XXIL.title: Road lines: yellow edges, triple white centre
sz-XXIL.summary: Yellow lines at the edge of the road, and sometimes a triple white centre line. South Africa, Lesotho and Botswana use the same style.

sz-Y6BK.title: Plate: long, green strip at the bottom
sz-Y6BK.summary: Long plates with a green strip along the bottom. Some South African plates look similar, so check other clues before guessing.

sz-Yn7m.title: Landscape: unusually flat east, hills far away
sz-Yn7m.summary: The east is unusually flat, with mountains often visible in the distance.

sz-e0dy.title: Language: Portuguese text in a border town
sz-e0dy.summary: Portuguese writing most likely means a small town on the Mozambique border, where Portuguese is spoken.

sz-eMUU.title: Roadside: concrete bus shelters
sz-eMUU.summary: Concrete bus shelters are common along the roads.

sz-f8Wu.title: Coverage: flat, dry grass, dirty camera
sz-f8Wu.summary: On the MR3 south of Ngomane: flat land, long dry grass, and dirt on the camera lens.

sz-oFsa.title: Landscape: distinct ridge to the east
sz-oFsa.summary: On the MR8 in the south-east, along the border, a clear ridge rises to the east.

sz-pB4I.title: Landscape: golden grass on western mountains
sz-pB4I.summary: In the west, mountains covered in pristine golden grass. Long grass grows nearly everywhere, but this clean golden colour is typical of the western highlands.

sz-pnyI.title: Landscape: very dark green wooded mountains
sz-pnyI.summary: In the centre-south, mostly along the MR9, the hills are tall, wooded and a deep dark green. The rest of the country looks lighter and more golden.

sz-sSv1.title: Landscape: green wooded hills, tall golden grass
sz-sSv1.summary: Green hills with trees and tall golden grass. Lesotho's mountains are bare and rarely have long grass.

differs.how: Bare, barren mountains with little long grass

sz-wTEf.title: Landscape: savannah, narrow dirt tracks
sz-wTEf.summary: A nature reserve with narrow dirt tracks, tall grass and open savannah scenery.
